title: Vacuum energy secrecy to prevent weaponization
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Vacuum energy secrecy to prevent weaponization, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
what if the
government discovered that it's not that
hard after all
to to access the physical vacuum and
extract energy from it.

plain: Kirk McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, asks podcast host Jesse Michels to imagine that the government discovered it is not that hard to draw energy from empty space, sometimes called vacuum energy. He links the idea to the inventor Nikola Tesla and to another inventor, T. T. Brown, and suggests such a discovery would be kept secret so it could not be turned into a weapon.
